name: How can I make a small rental bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I make a small rental bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small rental bathroom feel larger, consider several design strategies. Light-colored paint and large format tiles create an expansive feel. A wall-mounted vanity or a pedestal sink frees up floor space, as does a frameless glass shower enclosure instead of a shower curtain. Incorporate good lighting, including recessed lights and a well-lit mirror. Strategic use of mirrors can also visually expand the room. These elements collectively contribute to an open and airy perception.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use light colors, large tiles, wall-mounted vanities, and frameless glass showers. Good lighting and mirrors can also make a small bathroom feel more spacious.
